clinical_tests.name: functional_form_LR
clinical_tests.method: linear versus fixed five-knot RCS Cox LR

families.clinical: global and per-term classic GT log-time PH, plus linear-versus-fixed-RCS LR
families.residual: HC3 nonlinear mean and variance tests across all retained markers

inference.interpretation: Inference depends on model and permutation assumptions; diagnostics do not certify them.

clinical_fit.separation_method: pending Newton step per SD; coefficient magnitude alone is not separation

provenance.mean_directions: standardized raw numeric squared/cubed beyond clinical span
provenance.variance_directions: clinical basis conditional on stratum intercepts; squared residual/(1-h) response

engineering_qualification.claim_boundary: Finite main-study engineering gates in prespecified supported conditions; not universal 5% error control or certification of an individual dataset.
engineering_qualification.extension_limitations: The 500-subject, 300-marker and 3000-marker extensions do not establish broader qualification. In particular, large independent and linear marker families substantially reduce availability; power retention and conditional error bounds also remain limiting.

duplicates.note: Near-identical profiles are checked on panels of at least 200 markers.

null.assumption_note: Added-value residual permutation approximates a conditional null and assumes exchangeable residuals after the declared clinical-basis adjustment. Nonlinear marker-covariate relations can inflate false positives; family-wise error control also requires subset pivotality. Clinical Cox baseline misspecification, including non-proportional hazards, can invalidate conditional-null interpretation; multiplicity adjustment does not establish model adequacy.

resampling.inference_policy: Training diagnostics are refitted; withheld subsamples select no added-value markers and remain in the selection-frequency denominator.
resampling.note: No subsample was evaluated, so the stability of the selection was not assessed and no marker can be robust.

signature.correction_note: The subsample gap describes the diagnosis-governed procedure; it does not validate an exploratory marker signature fitted in the full cohort. Use the fixed external prediction metrics as exploratory estimates.
notes: No marker was selected, so the model holds the clinical covariates alone.
